item1.justification: The trace correctly applies element-by-element anticipation analysis under §102 and Graham/KSR factors (scope/content, differences, PHOSITA level, secondary considerations) under §103 at every relevant stage, with no misapplication of other statutory frameworks.

item2.justification: Every rejection and allowance decision cites specific claim elements and ties them to specific disclosures in US-2011315237-A1 (e.g., base skirt 114, moisture detector 150, ramp section 138, raised dam 139), and allowable claims are identified with specific features absent from the reference.

item3.justification: The §103 analysis is consistent with the §102 findings — claims anticipated at §102 are also found obvious at §103 using the same reference, and claims found novel at §102 (27–31) are also found non-obvious at §103, with no contradictions between stages.

item4.justification: With strictness at 0.502 and combination_threshold at 0.329 (easy combiner), the examiner readily finds obviousness from a single reference with minimal motivation-to-combine analysis and resolves ambiguous disclosures (e.g., claim 26's sensor placement, claim 32's control unit) toward rejection, consistent with the easy-combiner profile.

item5.justification: The final decision to reject claims 17–26, 32–33 and suggest amendment for 27–31 follows directly and logically from the accumulated §102/§103 stage analyses, with no reversal of prior-stage conclusions.
